name: review-tool-calls
title: Who owns the tool loop: machine-gated vs SDK-owned

origin.source: LangGraph review-tool-calls human-in-the-loop how-to, plus an AI SDK-owned multi-step tool loop

comparison.purpose: Two variants on one axis. Machine-owned: LangGraph's interrupt() over a proposed call becomes a first-class idle `reviewing` state, resumed by typed APPROVE / EDIT / REJECT events before the consequential tool runs. SDK-owned: the AI SDK runs the whole multi-step loop under `maxSteps` and the machine only appends its native response messages through an agent.messages transition.
